response.overview: With summer vacation just around the corner, the students of Aoi High School are bored in an endless afternoon class, but everything changes when they are suddenly startled by the sound of an explosion coming from somewhere near the science lab.  Among the shocked students is Yoshihiko Ohse, the teacher who caused the explosion.  What will become of the students?
response.title: Gakuen Sodom

titles.title: Sexo y violencia en las aulas
